description: This PHP script handles deletion of a Vendor record in the vtiger CRM system. It retrieves the vendor entity based on the current module, verifies the record ID, performs the delete operation, and then redirects the browser to a specified return URL.

methods.description: Static method to retrieve a singleton instance of a CRM entity for a given module.
